name: Awesome_Spatial_VQA_Benchmarks_ViewSpatial-Bench
description: A collection of spatial Visual Question Answering (VQA) benchmarks focused on evaluating models' understanding of spatial relations and layout in images. It measures a model's ability to answer questions about object placement, relative directions, and spatial configurations using visual and textual inputs. Designed to probe spatial reasoning capabilities of vision-language models.
reputation: A community-curated suite for spatial VQA used to evaluate spatial reasoning in vision-language models; moderately referenced in specialized VQA research.
